unit: GBP sterling (central interpretation and local conversion qualifications apply)

central.source: HC 1823 (301), pp. 2–3; year ending 5 January 1823; existing model reconciliation

local.status: currency sensitivity only; 39 jurisdictions; Tyrone excluded; mixed assessments/receipts

church.status: Rounded £500,000 assumption for 1822; 1835 tithe composition retained for comparison; rents excluded; alternative assumptions are illustrative

formula: central + local + dublin + church; share = total / denominator * 100

dublin.basis: Collected fixed taxes less wide-street receipts and precautionary quay deduction; assumed Irish pounds converted at 12/13, rounded down

exclusions: Church rents and other non-tithe Church income
Separate church cess and ministers money
Duplicate central grants and curate salaries
Collection costs and debt service as additional revenue
verification: Checked against local model and audits; 1835 Hansard inspected; primary scans not retranscribed in this draft
